# pksR: District-Level German Police Crime Statistics

[Deutsch](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/README.de.md)

`pksR` gives R users the district (Kreis) tables of the German Police
Crime Statistics (*Polizeiliche Kriminalstatistik*, PKS) published by
the Bundeskriminalamt, from 2003 onwards: as published, or harmonized to
one territorial boundary and offence classification.

The data come from versioned, validated releases of
[pksR-data](https://github.com/ofurkancoban/pksR-data), the pipeline
that downloads the original BKA files, extracts and harmonizes them and
checks every release. `pksR` downloads only the years you ask for, keeps
them in a local cache and checks every file against the SHA-256
checksums of the release.

Not to be confused with the CRAN package `pks` (probabilistic knowledge
structures).

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ofurkancoban/pksR")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(pksR)

# Total offences in every district, harmonized to the latest boundary
total <- pks_get(offence = "total")

# Offences by key, short name or label, in English or German
burglary <- pks_get(offence = c("residential_burglary", "435*00", "Wohnungseinbruchdiebstahl"))

# As published by the BKA, two years
published <- pks_get(years = 2024:2025, harmonize_to = NULL)

# Harmonized to another boundary year, with area weights for split districts
d <- pks_get(years = 2010:2015, harmonize_to = 2016, weights = "area")

# Rates recomputed after harmonization, with your own population if you like
rates <- pks_rates(d)

pks_offences("theft")       # offence keys, short names and labels
pks_breaks()                # known methodological breaks
pks_validate(d)             # consistency checks
pks_versions()              # available data releases
pks_cite()                  # how to cite package, data release and sources
```

## Languages

Messages, errors and offence labels are available in English and German.
`options(pksR.lang = "de")` switches to German; otherwise the language
of the R session is used.
[`pks_get()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_get.md)
and
[`pks_offences()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_offences.md)
also take `lang = "de"` or `lang = "en"`. The vignettes and this README
exist in both languages.

## Data releases

Every data release has a version (`2026.1`, `2026.2`, …) and never
changes; corrections become a new version. `pks_get(version = "2026.1")`
gives the same data at any time later. Each release is validated before
it is published: schema, one row per year, district and offence key, the
expected number of districts, national totals, conservation of totals
under harmonization and plausibility. See the [pksR-data
README](https://github.com/ofurkancoban/pksR-data) for details.

## Sources and terms of reuse

The package code is MIT licensed. The data keep the terms of their
sources:

- PKS tables: Bundeskriminalamt, [Datenlizenz Deutschland,
  Namensnennung, Version 2.0](https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/by-2-0).
  Source note: “PKS Bundeskriminalamt”, reporting year, version.
- Crosswalk: [Bundesinstitut für Bau-, Stadt- und
  Raumforschung](https://www.bbsr.bund.de) (BBSR), Umsteigeschlüssel,
  Datenlizenz Deutschland, Namensnennung, Version 2.0. Source note:
  “BBSR Bonn”.
- Municipality changes: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis),
  Gemeindeverzeichnis.

The harmonized data are changed data, not official BKA figures.
[`pks_cite()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_cite.md)
returns the full citation.

## Author

Ömer Furkan Çoban

# Package index

## Data

- [`pks_get()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_get.md)
  : Get district-level police crime statistics
- [`pks_example()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_example.md)
  : A small example panel

## Releases and citation

- [`pks_versions()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_versions.md)
  : List the available data releases
- [`pks_manifest()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_manifest.md)
  : Read the manifest of a data release
- [`pks_cite()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_cite.md)
  : Cite pksR, the data release and the data sources

## Metadata

- [`pks_offences()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_offences.md)
  : List the harmonized offence keys
- [`pks_breaks()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_breaks.md)
  : Known methodological breaks

## Analysis

- [`pks_rates()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_rates.md)
  : Recompute rates
- [`pks_validate()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_validate.md)
  : Validate a panel

## Cache

- [`pks_cache_info()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_cache_info.md)
  : Inspect the local cache
- [`pks_cache_clear()`](https://ofurkancoban.github.io/pksR/reference/pks_cache_clear.md)
  : Clear the local cache
